parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of duplicate detection in FIXTURE_DIRS when they are Path instances, but it introduces a potential performance regression by converting all fixture directories to strings.

issues.description: The change converts all fixture directories to strings, which may introduce a performance regression if FIXTURE_DIRS contains a large number of Path instances.
